definitions.meaning: Elapsed seconds since database instance startup; not management-agent uptime.
Filesystem used bytes reported by df; excludes available and reserved free space.
Filesystem total bytes reported by df including reserved capacity.
Cumulative bytes transferred by interface and direction in the current counter epoch.
IF-MIB operStatus up=1, down=0; all other enumerants unknown.
MySQL Queries status counter: statements executed by clients and stored programs; not committed transactions.
Rate of mysql.queries.total over a valid interval in the same database counter epoch.
Linux /proc/uptime first field: seconds since host boot, including suspend.
Linux /proc/loadavg one-minute runnable/uninterruptible task load average; not CPU utilization.
Linux top user plus system CPU percentage over its sampling interval; denominator is total logical CPU time, not a database process share.
Linux free used memory divided by MemTotal; used is MemTotal minus MemAvailable and excludes no database-specific attribution.
Cumulative bytes read from one Linux block accounting device in the current device epoch.
Cumulative bytes written to one Linux block accounting device in the current device epoch.
Cumulative milliseconds with I/O in progress for one Linux block accounting device in the current device epoch.
Filesystem used bytes divided by total bytes; not df capacity percent based on non-reserved capacity.
Rows visible in information_schema.PROCESSLIST, including idle sessions; requires PROCESS for complete instance scope.
Configured MySQL max_connections; not an operating-system process limit.
Com_commit explicit COMMIT commands; excludes implicit autocommit transactions.
Com_rollback explicit ROLLBACK commands; not all aborted transactions.
Estimated data_length plus index_length across visible non-system schemas; engine allocation statistics, not logical data bytes or host disk capacity.
Per-second rate of mysql.transaction_commands.commit_total, only within a valid counter epoch.
Per-second rate of mysql.transaction_commands.rollback_total, only within a valid counter epoch.
Sum of separately reset-checked explicit COMMIT and ROLLBACK command rates; excludes implicit autocommit.
Cluster pg_stat_activity backend rows, including background and idle backends; not MySQL connections.
Configured max_connections client connection limit; not capacity for all pg_stat_activity backend rows.
Current database xact_commit, including autocommit transactions; epoch includes pg_stat_database.stats_reset.
Current database xact_rollback; epoch includes pg_stat_database.stats_reset.
pg_database_size of the bound current database including its physical files; not logical row size or host disk usage.
Per-second rate of postgresql.transactions.commit_total, only within a valid counter epoch.
Per-second rate of postgresql.transactions.rollback_total, only within a valid counter epoch.
Sum of separately reset-checked xact_commit and xact_rollback rates in the bound current database.
V$SESSION rows including background and idle sessions in the bound Oracle container.
Oracle processes parameter: process limit, not session or client connection capacity.
V$SYSSTAT user commits in the bound instance/container; excludes rollbacks.
Per-second rate of oracle.transactions.commit_total, only within a valid counter epoch.
DM V$SESSIONS rows; not operating-system processes.
DM max_sessions configured session capacity; no synthetic default on missing value.
DM transaction commit count; excludes rollbacks and is not SQL execution count.
Per-second rate of dameng.transactions.commit_total, only within a valid counter epoch.
当前连接容器/数据库 DBA_DATA_FILES 的 BYTES 合计：永久数据文件已分配空间，包含系统表空间；不含临时文件、日志、备份，不是已使用空间或最大扩展容量。
当前连接容器/数据库 DBA_DATA_FILES 的 BYTES 合计：永久数据文件已分配空间，包含系统表空间；不含临时文件、日志、备份，不是已使用空间或最大扩展容量。
Slow_queries cumulative count; never an interval count or zero on failure.
Cumulative bytes received by the MySQL server; not host network traffic.
Cumulative bytes sent by the MySQL server; not host network traffic.
Cumulative Handler_read_rnd_next operations, not rows scanned during this interval.
Cumulative failed connection attempts; epoch required before a rate is calculated.
Allocated non-free buffer-pool pages/total pages; not host or whole database memory utilization. NULL on missing/zero total.
Threads_running snapshot; excludes sleeping client threads, not host CPU.
Threads_connected snapshot; not host process utilization.
Open_files server status snapshot; not an OS descriptor limit.
Key_blocks_used snapshot; not bytes or host memory.
Key_blocks_unused snapshot; no synthetic capacity when zero.
1 minus cumulative physical reads/read requests at this snapshot; not interval cache hit rate. NULL for missing/zero denominator.
Cumulative table cache hits/(hits+misses) at this snapshot; overflows are separate events and excluded. NULL for no requests.
Used key-cache blocks/(used+unused) snapshot; NULL for no configured blocks.
SUM(n_dead_tup) estimate over visible user tables in current database; NULL on no tables.
Cumulative idx_scan/(idx_scan+seq_scan) across current database user tables; not an index hit ratio.
Number of user tables whose last_vacuum is non-NULL; not vacuum event count.
Number of user tables whose last_autovacuum is non-NULL; not autovacuum event count.
Current database cumulative shared-buffer hits/(hits+disk reads); NULL for no block reads. Not OS cache hit rate.
Age of last replayed transaction timestamp; NULL without replay. Increases on idle standby and is not actual replication lag.
Maximum used/allocated permanent tablespace ratio in bound container, including system; not autoextend max capacity.
Oracle V$SYSSTAT execute count in the bound instance/container; includes repeated executions, not transaction count.
Active V$SESSION rows in the bound container; not host CPU.
SGA bytes in the bound instance/container. Unrounded bytes replace the old rounded MiB representation.
Total PGA allocated bytes in the bound instance. Unrounded bytes replace the old rounded MiB representation.
Cumulative 1 - physical reads/(db block gets + consistent gets) in bound instance/container; not host memory or PGA utilization.
V$LOCK rows with BLOCK=1; not deadlock count.
DM V$SYSSTAT sql executed count in the bound database; not transaction count.
DM memory-pool DATA_SIZE/TOTAL_SIZE; not host memory utilization.
RAT_HIT of DM buffer pool ID 0 as percent; missing row is unavailable.
DM V$LOCK rows with BLOCK=1; not total locks.
Current retained V$DEADLOCK_HISTORY row count; not monotonic events since startup.
free -b used memory bytes; not database memory.
free -b total physical memory bytes.
/proc/loadavg five-minute runnable/uninterruptible task load average.
/proc/loadavg fifteen-minute runnable/uninterruptible task load average.
free used/total swap; real zero when no configured swap.
ps -e process row count at this snapshot.
Maximum pcpu in the bounded top 20 processes sorted by CPU; ps lifetime CPU percent, not host CPU.
Maximum pmem within top 20 processes sorted by CPU; not necessarily host-wide maximum memory consumer.
Filesystem bytes available to an unprivileged process from df; excludes reserved free blocks.
df inode IUse percentage; NULL where filesystem does not report inodes.
Cumulative interface receive/transmit errors or drops by event, direction and lifecycle epoch.
MIB-II sysUpTime centiseconds converted to seconds since management subsystem initialization, not device boot time.
IF-MIB adminStatus up=1, down=0; testing unknown.
IF-MIB nominal per-direction link capacity, ifHighSpeed preferred; rx and tx each use this denominator on full-duplex links.
IF-MIB received octets; octets prefer Counter64 and fall back to Counter32; errors/discards use standard Counter32.
IF-MIB received errors; octets prefer Counter64 and fall back to Counter32; errors/discards use standard Counter32.
IF-MIB received discards; octets prefer Counter64 and fall back to Counter32; errors/discards use standard Counter32.
IF-MIB transmitted octets; octets prefer Counter64 and fall back to Counter32; errors/discards use standard Counter32.
IF-MIB transmitted errors; octets prefer Counter64 and fall back to Counter32; errors/discards use standard Counter32.
IF-MIB transmitted discards; octets prefer Counter64 and fall back to Counter32; errors/discards use standard Counter32.
Public Counter Processor rx rate; octets converted to bits/s. Full-duplex directions are independent; never add rx+tx then divide by one link capacity.
Public Counter Processor rx rate; octets converted to bits/s. Full-duplex directions are independent; never add rx+tx then divide by one link capacity.
Public Counter Processor rx rate; octets converted to bits/s. Full-duplex directions are independent; never add rx+tx then divide by one link capacity.
Public Counter Processor tx rate; octets converted to bits/s. Full-duplex directions are independent; never add rx+tx then divide by one link capacity.
Public Counter Processor tx rate; octets converted to bits/s. Full-duplex directions are independent; never add rx+tx then divide by one link capacity.
Public Counter Processor tx rate; octets converted to bits/s. Full-duplex directions are independent; never add rx+tx then divide by one link capacity.
